description.description: Optional one-line comment describing the configuration purpose.

ipv4_mask.description: Truncate the last n bits of IPv4 addresses (default: 12).

ipv6_mask.description: Truncate the last n bits of IPv6 addresses (default: 84).

increment.description: Increment the anonymized IP address by n (default: 0).

output_file.description: Output file to write anonymized logs to. Leave empty to use stdout.

input_file.description: Input file or FIFO to read from. Leave empty to use stdin.

columns.description: List of 1-based column indices where IP addresses are expected (default: [1]).

delimiter.description: Field delimiter used in the log format (default: space).

regex_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to detect IP addresses (instead of -c).

skip_private.description: If true, skip masking addresses in private/reserved ranges (per IANA registry).

debug.description: If true, print debug messages to stderr.
